critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Production Snapshot's 'complete' stage count uses a SEPARATE query (count_documents with status=completed) vs other stages which use the same ticket list. This means complete count reflects all-time completed tickets, not filtered by tenant scope issue — but looking at the code it IS tenant-filtered (tenant_id in the query). No bug.

Minor: approval items in Pending Approvals show 'Unknown · signature · 1270h ago' for orphaned signatures (customer_id not in customers collection). These are test/demo data artifacts, not a bug in the new dashboard wiring.

Minor: The severity-strip data-testid query_selector selects the wrapper div itself (which has count span child too), returning count=0 for the strip itself. This is just a test artifact — the individual severity-[key] data-testids all return correct counts.
